name: Yakan Shinsatsu
source:
Main character lives in a rich family. He lives to satisfy his sexual desires and skips his elite school lessons. One day he gets into a traffic accident and is hospitalized. There is no serious injury, so he is going to pour his sexual frustration to the female doctor and nurse here.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
